resources.string: GTL records your route on this phone only. It does not send location, IMEI, or SIM identifiers to any server. Do not interact with the app while driving. You use it at your own risk. Logging runs as a visible foreground service with a notification.
Add MAPS_API_KEY to local.properties, then rebuild. OSM offline maps still work after download.
Open the system location panel to turn GPS on or choose high accuracy.
Show last logged route on map
Keep whole track on the screen

Allow location when asked. GPS and Compass update as soon as the app is open. Tap Start to record a route into SQLite on this phone, draw it on the Map, and fill the Route totals. Tap Stop to end the session. Menu → Saved tracks to delete a route or show it on the map. Settings picks usage (motorbike is the default), units, and whether the last track stays on the map. Download an OSM region for offline maps. Nothing is uploaded to our servers.

Settings has map and recording switches.

Use downloaded OSM map: when on, Map uses a Mapsforge file you downloaded. When off, it uses Google Maps.

Simplify track on map: when on, only the line drawn on Map is thinned. The stored route and the shared KMZ keep every accepted point.

Smooth recorded track: Kalman filter moves stored points before they are saved. The live accuracy circle stays on the raw GPS fix.

Hold still when stopped: the stored point does not wander while you are slower than the pause speed.

Show last logged route on map: after Stop, the last (or a selected) track stays on Map.

Keep whole track on the screen: while logging, each GPS refresh fits the whole track (you can still pan and zoom until the next fix).

Show accuracy marker: a light purple circle around you; its radius is the GPS accuracy in metres.

Kalman smooths stored points. Douglas–Peucker only thins the drawn line on Map. Runner default is every good fix and no map simplify, so a figure-8 stays visible. Simplify tolerance is a 1–20 m slider; lower keeps narrow loops, higher drops more vertices.

Storing points is separate from map simplify. Smart density uses speed bands from the 2014 logger (half again for runner, and half in a curve). Every good fix stores about once per min time (or sooner in a curve), and still drops points closer than 1 m.

Choosing a usage writes a full preset (smoothing, density, map simplify, and units). You can change any control afterwards.

Motorbike (default): metric units, smooth recorded track on, mid strength, hold still when stopped, smart density, simplify on at 6 m.

Runner: metric, smooth on, low strength (keeps zigzag and figure-8), hold still, every good, simplify off.

Car matches motorbike but simplify at 8 m.

Watercraft: ICAO units (knots, nautical miles, feet), otherwise the same as car (mid strength, smart density, simplify on at 8 m).

Aircraft: ICAO units (knots, nautical miles, feet), high strength, smart density, simplify on at 15 m.

Usage: activity type. Changing it reloads the preset, the sliders, and the units.

Units: Metric, Imperial, or ICAO on Route. Aircraft and watercraft default to ICAO; every other usage defaults to Metric. You can still pick another unit after the preset.

Use downloaded OSM map: Mapsforge file versus Google Maps.

Simplify track on map: fewer vertices on Map only. When the switch is on, a 1–20 m slider (1 m steps) sets how aggressive the thinning is. KMZ and odometer keep every stored point.

Show last logged route on map: after Stop, the last (or selected) track stays on Map.

Keep whole track on the screen: while logging, each GPS refresh fits the whole track. Pan and zoom stay allowed until the next fix.

Show accuracy marker: purple circle; radius is GPS accuracy.

Smooth recorded track: Kalman moves stored points before save. The HUD accuracy circle stays on the raw GPS fix.

Smoothing strength (when smoothing is on): continuous Low–High. Low keeps zigzag (runner). High draws smoother arcs (aircraft).

Hold still when stopped: the stored point does not wander below the pause speed.

Recording density: continuous Smart–Every good. Smart uses speed bands. Every good stores about once per min time (or sooner in a curve) and drops points closer than 1 m.

Live satellite counts (GPS L1/L5, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou, QZSS, NavIC), SNR quality, latitude, longitude, accuracy, provider, altitude, ambient temperature, and logging status. Temperature is the hardware sensor value, or 0 if this phone has no ambient sensor. While logging, Kalman can smooth stored points; the HUD lat/lon and accuracy circle stay on the raw fused fix. Smart density still uses the 2014 speed bands.

Session totals after Start: elapsed time, odometer, time moving, time waiting, speed, average speed, altitude, bearing, lean angle (phone flat on a motorbike tank), and temperature range when the sensor exists.

Centers on your current location when you open the tab. After Start it follows you and draws the recorded track. Kalman smooths stored points; Simplify only thins the drawn line. A light purple circle around you is the GPS accuracy (radius equals the accuracy in metres). Turn it off in Settings. With “Show last logged route on map” a saved track stays visible. “Keep whole track on the screen” fits the whole route after each GPS refresh while logging. Saved tracks → Show on map opens that session here.
Magnetic heading in degrees and a live compass dial. Works without Start, using the phone rotation sensor.

Menu → Share KMZ sends the current track as a KMZ file (KML plus play, pause, and stop icons). Open it with an external app such as Google Earth. If Google Earth is not installed, get it from Play Store, then open the shared file. Tap the play, pause, or stop icons on the map to see that point’s details.
